title: Rain Turns Venusaur Into a Pokémon Beacon
premise: After rain, Venusaur’s flower smells stronger and draws other Pokémon toward it.
audiencePromise: Follow Venusaur’s scent from sunlight fragrance to a rain-powered Pokémon beacon.
openLoop: Why do other Pokémon follow Venusaur after a rainy day?
payoff: Rain strengthens Venusaur’s flower scent, attracting other Pokémon, while its aroma can also soothe people.
engagementQuestion: Rain beacon or sunlight calm, which Venusaur flower wins?

voice.instructions: Warm, cinematic curiosity. Start with urgent surprise, then slow slightly for each reveal. Stress “stronger” and “attracts.” End with an inviting, debatable lift.

scenes.headline: RAIN MAKES A BEACON
scenes.narration: Rain turns Venusaur into a Pokémon beacon.
scenes.caption: ONE FLOWER. A STRONGER SIGNAL.

scenes.headline: SUNLIGHT RELEASES FRAGRANCE
scenes.narration: Its back flower already releases fragrance in sunlight.
scenes.caption: THE PETALS GIVE OFF A PLEASANT SCENT.

scenes.headline: RAIN MAKES IT STRONGER
scenes.narration: Then rain passes, and that flower smells even stronger.
scenes.caption: THE SCENT CLOUD EXPANDS AFTER RAIN.

scenes.headline: OTHER POKÉMON FOLLOW IT
scenes.narration: That stronger scent attracts other Pokémon to Venusaur.
scenes.caption: SILHOUETTES FOLLOW THE FLOWER’S TRAIL.

scenes.headline: ITS AROMA SOOTHES PEOPLE
scenes.narration: Its flower aroma can also soothe people's emotions.
scenes.caption: ONE FLOWER CAN CALL POKÉMON AND CALM PEOPLE.

scenes.headline: BEACON OR CALM?
scenes.narration: Rain beacon or sunlight calm, which Venusaur flower wins?
scenes.caption: PICK VENUSAUR’S BEST FLOWER POWER.
